# opensearch_transform (Resource)

Provides an OpenSearch Transform job. Please refer to the OpenSearch Transforms documentation for details.

The resource starts or stops the transform job (via the `_start`/`_stop` Transforms API) to match the `enabled` field of the configured `body`, since creating or updating the job configuration alone does not start execution.

Note that `continuous`, `source_index`, `target_index`, `data_selection_query`, `groups`, and `aggregations` cannot be changed after creation; OpenSearch will reject such updates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a transform job that aggregates ecommerce sample data by customer
# gender and day of week into a summarized target index.
resource "opensearch_transform" "ecommerce" {
  transform_id = "ecommerce_transform"

  body = jsonencode({
    transform = {
      enabled     = true
      continuous  = true
      description = "Sample transform job"

      schedule = {
        interval = {
          period     = 1
          unit       = "Minutes"
          start_time = 1602100553
        }
      }

      source_index = "opensearch_dashboards_sample_data_ecommerce"
      target_index = "ecommerce_transform"
      page_size    = 1

      groups = [
        {
          terms = {
            source_field = "customer_gender"
            target_field = "gender"
          }
        },
        {
          terms = {
            source_field = "day_of_week"
            target_field = "day"
          }
        },
      ]

      aggregations = {
        quantity = {
          sum = {
            field = "total_quantity"
          }
        }
      }
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `body` (String) The transform job document, wrapped in a top-level `transform` key.
- `transform_id` (String) The id of the transform job.

### Optional

- `primary_term` (Number) The primary term of the transform job version.
- `seq_no` (Number) The sequence number of the transform job version.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opensearch_transform.ecommerce ecommerce_transform
```
